Author: Serpens66
Name: Unit Costs
Description: Configure recruit costs in Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Play -recruits are missing- if this is the reason for not being able to recruit
Do not highlight units as recruitable if extra costs are missing.
Also display current amounts of extra costs in tooltip
Removed support to change vanilla material costs of european units for everyone, because I think the extra costs for humans is enough and it makes this mod less complicated.
